provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Gaia Project rulebook (Z-Man / Feuerland, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Choose a first player; they take the first player marker

byPlayers.1: sector tiles 01-07 as shown, 05-07 outlined side up
byPlayers.2: sector tiles 01-07 as shown, 05-07 outlined side up
byPlayers.3: all 10 sector tiles as shown, 05-07 solid side up
byPlayers.4: all 10 sector tiles as shown, 05-07 solid side up

steps.text: Research board beside it: the 9 green-marked standard tech tiles randomly on the tech spaces, the rest stacked on their matching tiles
One random advanced tech tile between levels 4 and 5 of each research area; box the rest
Set aside the Gleens' federation token; a random federation token on level 5 of Terraforming; stack the rest in 6 piles, green side up
Scoring board: a random round scoring tile on each numbered space and a random final scoring tile on each space by the ranking tracks
{n} random round boosters beside the board
Action tokens, Gaia Planet tokens, Lost Planet, power tokens, Q.I.C. and record tokens as the supply

steps.note: Later games: choose any faction board in turn order

steps.text: Set up your faction board with its structures, resources and research tokens; take any level-1 one-time bonuses
A player token on 10 VP; one satellite on each 0 space of the scoring board
Place your first mines (first game: as the rulebook diagram shows), taking them left to right
From the last player counterclockwise, each chooses a round booster
Neutral player: two satellites of an unused color on the ranking tracks at the numbers on the final scoring tiles
Solo: set up the Automa per its rulebook
